<p>The proposal would result in the loss of consented landscaping which was approved under planning applications reference 17/01906/FUL and 18/01855/CDN, resulting in a net loss of biodiversity and urban greening and a failure of the extant development to comply with the original permission. That landscaping would be replaced with a car parking space in an inherently car free development.&nbsp;</p><p>The proposals are therefore contrary to:</p><p><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt;">- National Planning Policy Framework&nbsp;</span>National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, 2024)<o:p></o:p></p><p><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt;">- Policy D4, G5, G6, T6 and T6.1 of the London Plan (March 2021);</span></p><p class="MsoNormal"></p><p><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt;">- Policies SP2, DMD1, SP6, DMNE2, DMNE3, SP8 and DMT2 of&nbsp;</span>The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2020-2037 (2024)</p>

<div>The scale, siting and design of the proposed development are considered harmful to the appearance of the built form of the block of flats and character of the area.
